seriesName: Nebius AI Cloud on-demand GPU rental rates by chip
notes: All four points are on-demand GPU-hour rates listed on the same Nebius pricing page, as of the date checked (2026-08-25). This contextualizes the bullet's $4.50 H200 on-demand figure by showing where it sits relative to the older H100 and newer B200/B300 chips on the same provider's own price list. It does not directly cover Jarvislabs' $3.99 or Lambda's absence of H200, since rule 5 requires every point to come from one site; those two facts are already sourced separately in the bullet.
